name: com.spurvik/eu-ai-act
title: Spurvik EU AI Act
description: 10 zero-key tools: live URL & batch domain scan, C2PA check, RFP auto-responder, AI Act risk & badge

tools.name: spurvik_setup_snippet
tools.description: Return a setup snippet for openai, anthropic, google-genai, vercel-ai-sdk, mastra, openai-agents, or langgraph. Provider clients are wrapped with withSpurvik. The Vercel AI SDK snippet passes spurvikMiddleware to wrapLanguageModel. The Mastra snippet calls withSpurvikMastra. The OpenAI Agents snippet calls withSpurvikModelProvider. The LangGraph snippet calls withSpurvikLangGraph and spurvikInterrupt. The snippet is built from the installed spurvik exports (`spurvik` or `spurvik-sdk`, including `spurvik/ai`, `spurvik/langgraph`, `spurvik/mastra`, and `spurvik/openai-agents`). The disclosure label is a separate React client snippet that imports `spurvik/react`. `riskTier` is a sample value. Set your own classification (as provider or deployer); Spurvik does not classify your use case. The SDK logs the call and attaches an HMAC receipt. It does not mark content. Also accepts react, python, fastapi, langchain, pydantic-ai (zero-dependency Python 3.10+ helper at https://spurvik.com/r/spurvik_guard.py), shopify (.liquid Online Store 2.0 section), wordpress (plugin .zip & wp_footer), gtm / google-tag-manager (importable GTM container .json), webflow, and html. Pass optional domain and locale to prefill 1-click Console signup, readiness report, and white-label links.

target.description: SDK, framework, CMS, or builder to generate setup code for (for example, openai, anthropic, vercel-ai-sdk, react, python, fastapi, langchain, shopify, wordpress, gtm, webflow, html; natural aliases like google-tag-manager, lovable, supabase, nextjs, n8n, make, gemini, claude are also accepted at call time).

framework.description: Optional alias for target when a caller passes framework instead of target.

runtime.description: Optional runtime environment: node, next, vercel, or supabase-edge (Deno Edge Functions).

domain.description: Optional public domain or HTTPS URL of your app or store (for example, acme.eu). Prefills signup, report, and white-label links.

locale.description: Optional EU language code (for example, de, fr, es, it, nl, da, sv) to localize Console signup and report links.

tools.name: spurvik_find_unwrapped_calls
tools.description: Heuristic static scan of one directory inside the workspace root for AI client calls that are not passed through withSpurvik, spurvikMiddleware, withSpurvikMastra, withSpurvikModel, withSpurvikModelProvider, withSpurvikLangGraph, or spurvikInterrupt. A StateGraph constructor is reported when the file does not call withSpurvikLangGraph. A bare interrupt() call is reported when the file does not call spurvikInterrupt or resolveLangGraphInterrupts. The scan reads .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs, .mts, and .cts files. It does not read .md or .mdc files. Results are file:line. The line number is 1-based and counts every newline, including comments and strings. This is a heuristic, so it can miss a call or report one that is already wrapped. The scan does not change files and does not use the network. Paths that leave the workspace, including '..', are rejected. The scanner skips files named .env or .env.* (any case), including through symlinks and hard links. Over HTTP there is no workspace directory. Pass code (a string, max 128 KB) or files (an array of { path, content }). If neither is passed, this tool explains that, and how to run the local stdio MCP server or /spurvik:check for a directory scan.

code.description: Inline TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python source code (up to 128 KB) to inspect for unwrapped LLM SDK calls.

files.description: Array of project source files ({ path, content }) to inspect in memory for unwrapped OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Vercel AI SDK, or LangChain calls.

path.description: Relative file path (for example, src/chat.ts or app/main.py).

content.description: UTF-8 source text of the file (inspected in memory only, never persisted).

domain.description: Optional public website or app domain (for example, personio.de) to prefill CI guide and EU Console signup links.

locale.description: Optional EU language code (for example, de, fr, nl, da, sv, es, it) for localized CI guide and Console signup links.

tools.name: spurvik_explain_receipt
tools.description: Explain the fields of an HMAC provenance receipt JSON. If signingSecret is passed, or SPURVIK_SIGNING_SECRET is set, check the HMAC locally with `verifyProvenanceSignature`, which checks that the record's signed fields still match the HMAC-SHA-256 signature. It does not show that a notice was shown, that output is marked, or that your system meets the Act. The signing secret is not logged. Omit the secret to explain the fields without checking.

receipt.description: A Spurvik Art. 12 provenance receipt JSON object or JSON string (inspected in memory without storing raw data).

signingSecret.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 signing secret (>= 16 characters) to recompute and check the receipt signature in memory.

domain.description: Optional public website or app domain (e.g. personio.de) to prefill the Art. 12 HMAC cockpit and EU signup links.

locale.description: Optional EU language code (en, de, fr, nl, da, sv, es, it) for localized Art. 12 & GDPR HMAC documentation.

tools.name: spurvik_marking_hooks
tools.description: Explain how to plug your own Article 50(2) marking into marking.text or marking.media. Spurvik does not mark content. withSpurvik and spurvikMiddleware log the call and attach an HMAC receipt. A hook runs only when you supply one. The signed text trailer is an application-level binding you can opt into. It is not, by itself, an Article 50(2) machine-readable mark.

surface.description: Output modality to generate EU AI Act Art. 50(2) provenance marking hooks for: text, media (images/audio/video C2PA), or both.

domain.description: Optional public website or store domain (for example, charlie-paris.com) to prefill C2PA checker and EU signup links.

locale.description: Optional EU language code (for example, de, fr, nl, da, sv, es, it) for localized C2PA guide and signup links.

tools.name: spurvik_scan_live_url
tools.description: Scan one public page (bare domain or http(s) URL, for example stepnetwork.dk) for AI chat widgets and AI SDKs and check whether a visible EU AI Act Article 50(1) notice is present. Returns the host, HTTP status, findings, the suggested notice language, a one-line badge.js fix, the full report link, the agency portfolio link, signup links with the host prefilled as appUrl, and a live Art. 50 status shield in Markdown that you can offer to add to the project README.md. Heuristic: reads the HTML of one page only. Not legal advice.

url.description: Public domain or http(s) URL, for example stepnetwork.dk.

tools.name: spurvik_batch_scan_domains
tools.description: Scan 1 to 10 public domains or http(s) URLs (for example an agency's client sites) for AI chat widgets and AI SDKs, and check each page for a visible EU AI Act Article 50(1) notice. Every entry is checked first: if any entry is localhost, a private or reserved IP or an internal host, the whole batch is refused and nothing is fetched. Returns the number of gaps, one row per host (HTTP status, widgets, SDKs, notice, gap), each host's report link and README status shield, a one-line badge.js fix for each gap, and links to the portfolio cockpit, Team (€79/mo) and Done-For-You (€199 once per site). At most 4 pages are fetched at once. Heuristic: reads the HTML of one page per domain. Not legal advice.

domains.description: 1 to 10 public http(s) URLs or bare domains, for example ["stepnetwork.dk", "folk.app"]. Duplicate hosts are scanned once.

tools.name: spurvik_classify_ai_act_risk
tools.description: Self-assessment of an AI system under the EU AI Act from a few answers: prohibited (Article 5), high-risk (Annex III), Article 50 transparency only, minimal risk, or outside the EU. Returns the duties with their dates and the Spurvik setup steps. Not legal advice and not a decision under Article 6.

inEu.description: Placed on the market or used in the EU.

annexIii.description: Annex III high-risk areas that apply.

useCase.description: Optional plain-language system summary (up to 4000 chars, never echoed or stored) as an alternative to structured inEu/annexIii flags.

siteDomain.description: Optional public company domain (for example, personio.de) to prefill report, questionnaire, and Console links.

locale.description: Optional EU language code (for example, de, fr, nl, da, sv, es, it) for localized questionnaire and Console links.

tools.name: spurvik_generate_art50_badge
tools.description: Generate a copy-paste EU AI Act Article 50 notice: a badge.js <script> tag or a React <AIDisclosureLabel /> snippet, in any of the 24 EU languages, with a preview of the notice text. The language is inferred from a domain-like systemName when locale is omitted.

systemName.description: Product or assistant name, or the site domain.

locale.description: Official EU ISO 639-1 language code for the Art. 50 notice (inferred from domain ccTLD when omitted).

notice.description: Article 50 disclosure variant: interaction (Art. 50(1)), generated, synthetic_media (Art. 50(4)), public_interest_text, or emotion_biometric.

format.description: Snippet output format: script (1-line HTML badge.js tag) or react (<AIDisclosureLabel /> JSX component).

placement.description: Badge position on page: bottom-right (default), bottom-left, or inline.

theme.description: Color theme for the Shadow DOM badge: dark, light, or auto.

whitelabel.description: Hide the Spurvik trust link (Pro or Done-For-You).

tools.name: spurvik_check_image_c2pa_url
tools.description: C2PA JUMBF manifest & CDN-strip checker for one public https image URL (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 4 MB) OR a bare public store/site domain (for example stepnetwork.dk or charlie-paris.com — auto-discovers the frontpage og:image / hero image in 1 hop), ahead of the 2 December 2026 EU AI Act Art. 50(2) machine-readable marking cutoff. Returns the format, byte size and file name, whether a C2PA (Content Credentials) manifest is embedded, the signature and trust-list result, whether the URL goes through an image optimizer that strips C2PA (/_next/image, Shopify CDN /cdn/shop/, Jetpack Photon, Webflow CDN, Cloudinary, imgix, Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/image/), a visible "AI-generated" notice snippet, and links. Read-only: it never signs or adds a manifest. Fetched through an SSRF gate (https only, public addresses, 8 s, 4 MB) and checked in memory; nothing is stored. 10 checks per minute per address, shared with https://console.spurvik.com/c2pa.

url.description: Public https URL of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image up to 4 MB (e.g. https://example.com/hero.png) OR a bare public store/site domain (e.g. charlie-paris.com) for 1-hop frontpage hero-image discovery.

tools.name: spurvik_vendor_questionnaire_answers
tools.description: Zero-network, deterministic Markdown answers to the five EU AI Act questions enterprise buyers ask in vendor security questionnaires and DPO RFPs: Q1 Art. 50(1) notice and 2 Dec 2026 Art. 50(2) provenance, Q2 Art. 12 cryptographic event logging (keyed HMAC-SHA256 inputHash/outputHash, SHA-256 recordHash chained by prevLogHash), Q3 GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) zero-prompt minimisation and EU Frankfurt residency, Q4 Art. 14 deterministic human approval gates, Q5 audit retention, DPO evidence and Annex IV documentation. Answers match the chosen Spurvik plan: Free €0 (10,000 events/mo, 30 days), Pro €19/mo (250,000, 90 days, white-label badge, hosted approval queue, DPO engineering summary), Team €79/mo (2,000,000, 12 months, Annex IV draft, webhook export) or Done-For-You €199 once (24h install, signed DPO readiness report, 1 year of Pro). Every field is optional. Ends with links to the interactive questionnaire and signup. Review the wording against your own setup before you send it.

plan.description: Spurvik plan the answers describe: free, pro (default), team or concierge (Done-For-You).

provider.description: Model provider or agent framework: openai (default), anthropic, google-genai, vercel-ai-sdk, langgraph, openai-agents, mastra, python or custom.

hasHighRiskActions.description: Agents or tools can trigger refunds, emails, permission changes or deletions. Defaults to true.

generatesMedia.description: The product generates synthetic images, audio or video (Art. 50(2)). Defaults to false.

domain.description: Optional public hostname of the product, for example acme.eu. Prefills the report and signup links; a value that is not a public hostname is ignored and not echoed.

locale.description: Optional answer language: en (default), de (German DSB), fr (French DPO), nl (Dutch FG), da (Danish DPO), sv (Swedish DSO), es (Spanish DPD) or it (Italian RPD/DPO).
